messages:
Nina: Quick heads-up — Mako-21B int6 canary showed intermittent slowgen spikes and occasional OOMs under multi-turn tests.
Carlos: spike pattern? p95 or tail only?
Nina: mostly p99. p95 ok. Repro locally with convo-long suite. Happens when gen > 400 and context > 3k.
Avery: do you have batch/window settings? Some int6 kernels keep extra scratch for dequant if batch window is large.
Nina: defaults: max_new_tokens=512, batch_window_ms=25, batch_cap=12.
Carlos: paste snippet of worker log when it OOMs.
Nina: log: ```
[2025-01-14T09:13:02Z] gen:start model=mako-21b-int6 ctx=3200 gen=520
[2025-01-14T09:13:02Z] alloc: need 1.4GB contiguous, free=1.1GB fragmented
[2025-01-14T09:13:02Z] kernel: fallocate split -> created 37 small slots
[2025-01-14T09:13:02Z] OOM: failed to merge slots, abort generation
```
Avery: classic slot-churn. Two quick mitigations: reduce max_new_tokens for convo endpoints and aggressive microbatching (lower batch_cap but smaller window) so per-request scratch is smaller.
Carlos: propose experiments: (1) max_new_tokens=256, batch_window_ms=10, batch_cap=8; (2) enable compactor with compaction_threshold=0.55 and compaction_rate=0.15; (3) set kv.prefetch_limit=1500 for long sessions.
Nina: running (1) now on local rbench: `rbench --model mako-21b-int6 --suite convo-long --concurrency 10 --max_new_tokens 256 --batch_window_ms 10 --batch_cap 8`
Perf-bot: queued perf run -> https://ci.internal/runs/9002
Nina: quick results: 20k requests, OOMs=0, p99 reduced by 14% vs canary, p95 +2%. Quality (turn-coherence) unchanged.
Avery: good. Try (2) compactor next; compaction might help at scale but watch CPU.
Carlos: add rollout plan: canary 5% with (1) + compactor.enable=true on 2 nodes, monitor OOM rate, p99, and CPU steal. Rollback if OOM>0.03% or p99 regresses >10%.
Deploy-bot: Canary scheduled: mako-int6-canary-2025-01-14 -> targets=5%
Nina: adding config entry to model-onboard checklist: "int6 convos -> default max_new_tokens=256, batch_window_ms<=12, enable slot_compactor with threshold 0.55". Will add notes on CPU tradeoff.
Carlos: also add a short eval harness that simulates bursty small-requests + long contexts; we missed that earlier.
Avery: thank you — circling back after 24h canary metrics. :thumbsup:
